clips.text: Passing through it the ray of existence becomes divided into many rays and many colors.
What is one at the root becomes many at the branches.
The root is eternal - beginningless, endless.
Branches are in time - they have their beginning, they have their end Branches are change.
Neither the root changes nor can it be changed.
Yes - one can desire it to be changed, and then such a desire inevitably takes one into failure and anguish.
Branches go on changing They cannot be stopped from changing.
But certainly it can be desired that they don't change, and then such a desire inevitably transforms itself into failure and anguish.
The West is in the first kind of failure and anguish.
